nodes.title: PROMPT • MiniMax H3 Image
widgets_values:
Edit the provided image_1 by ADDING TYPOGRAPHY ONLY. This is a strict image preservation task.

Keep the original photograph completely unchanged. Preserve the exact same person, facial features, expression, hairstyle, sunglasses, jacket, colors, lighting, geometric background, framing, camera angle, and image proportions. Do not crop, extend, redraw, retouch, enhance, recolor, or regenerate any part of the original image.

Create an elegant, high-impact YouTube thumbnail text overlay using these EXACT words:

H3-IMAGE
COMFYUI
OPTIMIZED WORKFLOWS

Place the typography mainly across the lower third of the image, avoiding the woman's eyes, glasses, nose, and mouth.

"H3-IMAGE" is the dominant headline: very large, bold, modern white sans-serif typography, with "H3" highlighted in bright cyan.

"COMFYUI" is a smaller secondary heading in white.

"OPTIMIZED WORKFLOWS" is a compact uppercase subtitle in cyan, positioned below the main heading.

Use precise typography, consistent letter spacing, sharp edges, professional graphic design, and excellent readability at small thumbnail size.

Add only a subtle dark translucent gradient or soft shadow directly behind the text if necessary for contrast. Do not otherwise modify the image.

Keep every letter fully visible inside the image boundaries with safe margins. Avoid overlapping the woman's face. Do not add any logos, icons, symbols, watermarks, extra words, frames, decorative graphics, or AI-themed elements.

The final image must be the original photograph with only the requested professionally designed text overlay added.

nodes.title: GUIDE / USAGE
widgets_values:
# ZetaLvX | MiniMax H3 Image
### Text-to-image · Image editing · Multi-reference

The same model supports image generation and image editing. Connect reference images only when needed.

**Text-to-image**
1. Keep all `image_0`–`image_15` inputs disconnected.
2. Enter a generation prompt in **PROMPT**.
3. Set the aspect ratio and target megapixels, then run the workflow.

**Image editing**
1. Add a built-in **Load Image** node and connect its IMAGE output to `image_0`.
2. Describe the requested edit and what should remain unchanged.
3. Refer to the source image as `<Picture 1>` in the prompt.

**Multi-reference generation or editing**
1. Connect additional Load Image nodes to `image_1`, `image_2`, etc.
2. Refer to the connected pictures in the prompt as `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, etc.
3. Describe each image's purpose, such as subject, outfit, composition, or background.

**Settings**
- Aspect-ratio selector with adjustable 4–20 MP target resolution.
- Sampler: **Euler**; scheduler: **Simple**; **6 steps**, **CFG 1**, **denoise 1**.
- Prompt enhancement is not included.
- Connect the VAE for editing so the reference images can also condition the latent representation.

**Links**
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@zetalvx
- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Zetalvx
- GitHub: https://github.com/ZETALVX

nodes.title: MODEL FILES
widgets_values:
# Model files
**Diffusion model**
`minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**Text encoder**
`qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**VAE**
`minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors`

The same model configuration is used for text-to-image and image editing. Image references are optional.

### Prompt enhancement
An additional prompt-enhancement model is not required by this workflow. You can write a detailed prompt directly in the conditioning node.

nodes.title: RESOLUTION / QUALITY
widgets_values:
# Resolution and quality
The model renders directly at the requested resolution: **no upscaler is used**.

Reference ~16–17 MP sizes published by MiniMax:
- Square: `4096 × 4096`
- 4:3: `4736 × 3552`
- 3:2: `5024 × 3360`
- 16:9: `5472 × 3072`
- 21:9: `6272 × 2688`

The dynamic control uses **exact decimal megapixels** (1 MP = 1,000,000 pixels), so it does not try to force the exact preset dimensions from the official table.

For clean comparisons: keep the same seed, prompt, steps, and sampler.

Steps are **6** because the model is distilled and does not use a classic negative prompt or standard CFG workflow.

nodes.title: IMAGE INPUTS / PROMPT REFERENCES
widgets_values:
# Image inputs and prompt references

The inputs on the ComfyUI node are named `image_0` through `image_15`. MiniMax H3 Image identifies connected pictures in the text prompt using **`<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, ...**.

| ComfyUI input | Prompt reference when connected in order |
|---|---|
| `image_0` | `<Picture 1>` |
| `image_1` | `<Picture 2>` |
| `image_2` | `<Picture 3>` |
| ... | ... |
| `image_15` | `<Picture 16>` |

**The numbering in the prompt follows the order of connected images.** Empty inputs are skipped. For predictable references, connect images consecutively from `image_0`.

### Prompt examples
**Editing one image:**
`Edit <Picture 1> by changing the jacket to red. Preserve the subject's identity, face, pose, and background.`

**Combining references:**
`Use <Picture 1> for the subject, <Picture 2> for the outfit, and <Picture 3> for the background. Create a realistic cinematic photograph.`

**Without image inputs:**
Write a normal text-to-image prompt; do not include picture references.

The 16 input slots are optional. Additional connected references may increase memory usage and processing time.
